Container.Name: Mila
Container.Overview: Mila, a project manager for a person or a small team: tasks, projects, views, a wiki, time tracking and reports, in one program with its own database, kept in sync on every device. Its data is one folder. The setup link for the first account is in its log.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything Mila keeps: the database, files and backups.

Config.Name: Address
Config.Description: The address people use, such as https://mila.example.com behind a reverse proxy, or http://your-server:8080 on your network alone.

Config.Name: Email server
Config.Description: smtps://user:password@smtp.example.com:465 for sign-in links and reminders; empty prints them in the log.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Behind a reverse proxy, its address, which Mila's log names the first time a visitor comes through it. Empty, Mila believes no one about where visitors come from.
